name: EPIC 246032353
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 12, 16.4 solar radii and 2.15 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 246032353 (K2 campaign 12): PARAM radius (solar radii) 16.418612 (16th-84th percentiles 15.282145-17.034376), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 5,155 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 2.15 solar masses and 16.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,952 K at its surface.
